content:
Save the date — the deadline is nearly here: ITR filing for FY 2025-26 (AY 2026-27) is due 31 July 2026, just around the corner.

📌 31 July 2026 — Salaried individuals & non-audit taxpayers (ITR-1, ITR-2)
📌 31 August 2026 — Business/profession, non-audit (ITR-3, ITR-4)
📌 31 October 2026 — Tax audit cases
📌 30 November 2026 — Transfer pricing cases


Don’t wait till the last week. File early. File smart. ✅
